text:
Estimated meal: a Greek-style salad (tomato, cucumber, feta, dressing) and 5 sushi rolls (maki with chicken and cucumber), plus water and soy sauce.

Salad: about 200 g, including roughly 40 g feta and 10 g dressing oil. That comes to about 130 kcal.

Sushi: 5 thick pieces at roughly 40 g each is about 200 g. At about 1.5 kcal/g (rice, chicken, nori), that is about 300 kcal.

The "after" photo shows the salad and sushi gone, with a little dressing left in the bowl. The soy sauce looks mostly left over, with some smeared on the plate. The dressing cup is empty, so the dressing was used.

Eaten: about 400 g of food, roughly 430 kcal. Soy sauce adds a negligible amount.
